facts.fact: The SMART Office Management System is stated to have been developed in-house by SMART Zambia (the e-Government Division), which demonstrated it at the Ministry of Health headquarters.

The e-Government Division (SMART Zambia Institute) is rolling out the SMART Office system to the Ministry of Health, with the Ministries of Finance and Education, National Archives and commissions next; no date given in the text beyond the publication date 2025-06-23.
